President Murmu Pays Tribute at Swami Shraddhanand Centenary Event

President Droupadi Murmu paid tribute to Swami Shraddhanand on the martyrdom centenary at Gurukul Kurukshetra. The event also marked the diamond jubilee of the institution. The President recalled Swami Shraddhanand as a 12-year-old freedom fighter.
